now.text: In episode 38, Carnage steals life energy for Dormammu until a reversed portal pulls him in, along with Venom.

proposed.text: In episode 38, Carnage steals life energy for Dormammu until Venom throws him through the portal and follows him in.

evidence: In 'Carnage' (episode 38), Spider-Man reconfigures the probe to pull Dormammu back, but Dormammu's energy link to Carnage keeps the portal open, so Venom throws Carnage through it; when Carnage tries to drag Ashley with him, Venom jumps in after him and both are banished. The portal does not pull Carnage in by itself.

file_steps.title: Spider-Man (1994)
file_steps.text: In episode 37, with help from Baron Mordo and Dormammu, Cletus Kasady bonds with a symbiote and becomes Carnage.
